# llms.txt — AI usage guidance for ScanPings.net

  ScanPings is a browser-based internet speed testing and network diagnostics tool
  measuring download speed, upload speed, latency, and jitter using CDN-based,
  high-concurrency testing inspired by modern edge network methodologies.
